svg.title: MacBook Pro 16-inch (M5 Max, Liquid Retina XDR) — silver
svg.desc: Original front-view vector illustration, MIT (LICENSE.txt). Manufacturer specifications are references for measurements and product details, not sources of artwork. US catalog, 2026-11-20. Reference SKU: MGE74LL/A (Silver). 16.2-inch Liquid Retina XDR; native 3456 × 2234 px. Apple display reference (1260 × 772 px), front elevation: deck/lid/display widths ≈ 1258/1064/1030 px; lid top y=2, display bottom y≈685, deck starts y≈720, metal ends y≈765, feet end y≈770 (exclusive ends). Native aspect retained; lid meets deck at the visible seam. Attached housing approx. 108 px wide, ending at row 40; rounded top screen corners only. Corner radii, lens, recess and underside curves are approximations; feet clearance included without drawing the feet. Finish swatches are illustrative. Sources: https://www.apple.com/macbook-pro/specs/; https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-mac/macbook-pro; https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-pro/liquid-retina-xdr-display/specs/e/images/specs/16-inch/display_16_inch__bn4z91heotxy_large_2x.jpg; https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-pro/liquid-retina-xdr-display/specs/e/images/specs/16-inch/macbook_pro_16_inch__cqvg4x5ohjv6_large_2x.jpg
